post:
      description: Creates a new dashboard and returns its ID, full state, and metadata.
      operationId: post-dashboards
      parameters:
        - description: A required header to protect against CSRF attacks
          in: header
          name: kbn-xsrf
          required: true
          schema:
            example: 'true'
            type: string
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/Kibana_HTTP_APIs_kbn-dashboard-data'
      responses:
        '201':
          content:
            application/json:
              examples:
                createDashboardResponse:
                  description: |
                    Response to creating a dashboard. Returns the generated ID, the full dashboard state in `data`, and metadata. Default option values are always returned even when not explicitly set in the request. Panel `id` values are generated automatically.
                  summary: Create dashboard response
                  value:
                    data:
                      access_control:
                        access_mode: write_restricted
                      options:
                        auto_apply_filters: true
                        hide_panel_borders: false
                        hide_panel_titles: false
                        sync_colors: false
                        sync_cursor: true
                        sync_tooltips: false
                        use_margins: true
                      panels:
                        - config:
                            content: '## Web logs overview'
                          grid:
                            h: 15
                            w: 24
                            x: 0
                            'y': 0
                          id: a1b2c3d4-0001-4000-8000-000000000001
                          type: markdown
                        - config:
                            data_source:
                              index_pattern: kibana_sample_data_logs
                              time_field: timestamp
                              type: data_view_spec
                            ignore_global_filters: false
                            metrics:
                              - empty_as_null: false
                                operation: count
                                type: primary
                            sampling: 1
                            styling:
                              primary:
                                labels:
                                  alignment: left
                                position: bottom
                                value:
                                  alignment: right
                                  sizing: auto
                            title: ''
                            type: metric
                          grid:
                            h: 5
                            w: 12
                            x: 24
                            'y': 0
                          id: a1b2c3d4-0001-4000-8000-000000000002
                          type: vis
                        - config:
                            data_source:
                              index_pattern: kibana_sample_data_logs
                              time_field: timestamp
                              type: data_view_spec
                            ignore_global_filters: false
                            metrics:
                              - field: bytes
                                operation: average
                                type: primary
                            sampling: 1
                            styling:
                              primary:
                                labels:
                                  alignment: left
                                position: bottom
                                value:
                                  alignment: right
                                  sizing: auto
                            title: ''
                            type: metric
                          grid:
                            h: 5
                            w: 12
                            x: 36
                            'y': 0
                          id: a1b2c3d4-0001-4000-8000-000000000003
                          type: vis
                        - config:
                            axis:
                              x:
                                domain:
                                  rounding: false
                                  type: fit
                                grid:
                                  visible: true
                                labels:
                                  orientation: horizontal
                                scale: ordinal
                                ticks:
                                  visible: true
                                title:
                                  visible: false
                              'y':
                                anchor: start
                                domain:
                                  rounding: true
                                  type: full
                                grid:
                                  visible: true
                                labels:
                                  orientation: horizontal
                                scale: linear
                                ticks:
                                  visible: true
                                title:
                                  visible: true
                            layers:
                              - data_source:
                                  query: FROM kibana_sample_data_logs | STATS count = COUNT() BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
                                  type: esql
                                ignore_global_filters: false
                                sampling: 1
                                type: line
                                x:
                                  column: BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
                                'y':
                                  - axis_id: 'y'
                                    column: count
                            legend:
                              layout:
                                truncate:
                                  max_lines: 1
                                type: grid
                              placement: outside
                              position: right
                              visibility: hidden
                            styling:
                              interpolation: linear
                              overlays:
                                current_time_marker:
                                  visible: false
                                partial_buckets:
                                  visible: false
                              points:
                                visibility: auto
                            title: Requests over time
                            type: xy
                          grid:
                            h: 10
                            w: 24
                            x: 24
                            'y': 5
                          id: a1b2c3d4-0001-4000-8000-000000000003
                          type: vis
                      pinned_panels: []
                      title: Web logs overview
                    id: 3c4b8e10-d57a-11ef-9a52-4f3c2a8d0e1b
                    meta:
                      created_at: '2026-04-13T10:00:00.000Z'
                      managed: false
                      updated_at: '2026-04-13T10:00:00.000Z'
                      version: WzEwMiwxXQ==
              schema:
                additionalProperties: false
                type: object
                properties:
                  data:
                    $ref: '#/components/schemas/Kibana_HTTP_APIs_kbn-dashboard-data'
                  id:
                    description: The unique ID of the dashboard, as returned by the create or search endpoints.
                    type: string
                  meta:
                    $ref: '#/components/schemas/Kibana_HTTP_APIs_kbn-as-code-meta'
                required:
                  - id

                  - meta
